planRows.directoryName: Zemi Beach House, LXR Hotels & Resorts
planRows.shortDesc: Our boutique resort spans six acres of Anguilla's picturesque coastline, with direct access to Shoal Bay Beach. Experience personalized lessons on our tennis court and a choice of four outdoor pools, including an adult-only infinity pool and private cabanas. Perks include a 24-hour fitness center, an award-winning spa, and our concierge service.
planRows.headline: Spa tranquility by Shoal Bay Beach
planRows.locationShortDesc: We are located on the East end of Anguilla on Shoal Bay East.
planRows.directionsTo:
Getting to Anguilla is easy. Many guests choose to travel through St.
Maarten (SXM) Princess Juliana International Airport. Zemi Beach House
can arrange for a shared or private Sea Shuttle Service to greet guests at
the Airport and transfer them on a shared or private sea shuttle to
Blowing Point Ferry Terminal in Anguilla where they will take a taxi to
Zemi Beach House.
Guests can also fly directly into Anguilla's (AXA) Clayton J. Lloyd Airport
via Seaborne or Tradewinds from San Juan or other nearby islands. A
hotel representative will greet guests at the airport and place them in a
taxi.
